thread:
eva.k: Quick proposal  a 7-day "Prompt Challenge" to drive habit formation. Users opt-in, get a small daily credit + a prompt to run. Win = higher 7-day active rate and repeat prompt saves.

tom.s: Nice. How do we avoid spammy nudges? Suggest 1 push/email per day + optional Slack/Discord share. Keep messages tiny.

maya.p: Love the game layer. Variants: Challenge+Leaderboard, Challenge (no LB), Control (no challenge). Leaderboard shows top "prompters" by saves. Hypothesis: leaderboard adds social proof and boosts saves but might bias for power users.

eva.k: Metrics: daily run rate, prompt_save per active day, 7-day retention, % who convert in 14 days. Also measure churn from pushes.

luke.ops: Routing/flags: add LD flag prompt_challenge_v1 and user property challenge_cohort. UTM utm_campaign=prompt_challenge. We'll tag leads in HubSpot with lead_source=prompt_challenge if they claim credits. ETA for flag EOD.

growth-bot: Reminder: include eval on starter prompts to avoid any regressions: https://internal/evals/prompt-challenge-v1. Also add analytics events: challenge_opt_in, daily_prompt_run, prompt_save, leaderboard_view.

tom.s: Creative plan: 7 short micro-prompts (mix: copy, bug fix, email reply). We'll surface 3 per day. Small GIF for social showing progress and leaderboard.

maya.p: Nudges: Day 1: welcome + claim 10 credits; Day 2-7: small CTA to run today's prompt; bonus 50 credits if you save 5 prompts by day 7. That bonus tests escalation.

eva.k: Experiment config (minimal):
```
experiment: prompt_challenge_v1
cohorts: ["leaderboard", "challenge_only", "control"]
allocation: [33, 33, 34]
primary_metric: "7_day_retention"
secondary: ["prompt_save_rate", "daily_run_rate", "14d_conversion"]
```

luke.ops: Fraud note: cooldown on bonus claim (48h) and device/ip logging. HubSpot mapping: add challenge_cohort and bonus_claimed.

growth-bot: Recommend a tiny qual survey on completion toast: "Which prompt helped most? [copy|code|reply|other]" to capture signal.

eva.k: Owners: Maya (creative + prompts), Tom (copy + socials + GIF), Luke (flags + routing + hubspot), Eva (experiment lead + dashboard). Launch plan: internal soft Friday AM, public Monday 9am PT. Daily dashboard first 7 days.

maya.p: I'll draft the 21 micro-prompts and drop in Drive by EOD. Tom, want a raw recording for the GIF?

tom.s: Yes please, maya. I'll edit and return by noon tomorrow.

eva.k: Great. Sync tomorrow 10am for sign-offs. Thanks team :sparkles:
